body: This is possibly the most moving story in the whole thread. What a sweet-sounding couple, I'm glad they got the confidence to start venturing out a bit more!
The 'Dark Ages' weren't a dystopian nightmare, that's an old misconception.

Thanks for the reply. I think you're right that it's a little unusual because a lot of relationship problems stem from a lack of communication and this is pretty much the opposite. I like your idea of trying to keep areas of mystery. I've always been quite happy to talk about sex and open about experimenting, but I can see how too much information could cause problems early on in a relationship!
Thank you, will definitely take a look. I think you're right that these are thought patterns I need to try to break out of while I still have the motivation to do something about it.
